procedure_text: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将10.3g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待叔丁醇钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为98.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
procedure_summary: The methyl ester of the benzoic acid is cleaved by sodium tert-butoxide in tert-butanol at a controlled kettle temperature to give the sodium benzoate salt, the benzylic bromide being left untouched. The base is dripped in and allowed to disperse before the ester is poured in, the reaction is slightly exothermic, and its endpoint is checked by in-process liquid chromatography. The solvent is then stripped under reduced pressure and the crude salt goes straight into the etherification without isolation.

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入130mL THF、10.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.105mol)和11.8g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.12mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在10℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.8g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.7％。
procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide of the benzoate salt from the preceding step is displaced by trifluoroethoxide, generated in the pot from trifluoroethanol and sodium tert-butoxide in tetrahydrofuran, the salt being added in portions at a controlled kettle temperature and the mixture then held. The solvent is stripped, the residue dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the solid filtered, rinsed with water and dried to the target benzoic acid, whose content is measured by HPLC.
